personality.description: This person tends to generate original ideas quickly, then organizes them into a careful plan and pays close attention to details while carrying it out. In daily habits, they are socially active, comfortable initiating conversations, and often seek out stimulating people or settings, but they remain selective and somewhat guarded about trusting others’ intentions. When facing moral dilemmas, they usually analyze the situation from multiple angles, compare principles against practical consequences, and decide firmly in line with their own goals and standards, even if others disagree. In group discussions, they speak confidently and energetically, introduce new perspectives, and challenge weak arguments directly, often steering the conversation with a competitive, questioning tone.
